description: The detached acceptance is authentically signed (keyBindingValid=true) and its digest matches, but its policy_id (atap-extended) does not agree with metadata.accepting_authority (atap-basic): the acceptance is not bound to this output (boundToOutput=false). Authenticity and binding are separate properties; an authentic acceptance of a different policy is still not an acceptance of THIS output, and the package is REJECTED. Until the §4.3 binding family was promoted it verified valid:true.

expect.failureReason: acceptance invalid: acceptance policy_id does not match accepting_authority.policy_id.
